limitations.detail: A pretrained model's latent technical knowledge cannot be erased. Admissibility therefore requires packet evidence for every claimed concept and treats unsupported knowledge as PREMATURE_KNOWLEDGE.

A client-only GitHub Pages application cannot cryptographically hide bundled local answer keys. Browser gates can prevent visible, DOM, and accessibility-tree leakage before an attempt; high-stakes secrecy requires a server-side assessment service.
Lessons needing credentials, paid services, unavailable hardware, or third-party state must use approved fixtures or report BLOCKED_ENVIRONMENT.
No new real human-subject study is available in this automated run; the held-out human-reviewed calibration set remains the available calibration evidence.
